content.short: Ethereum is a layer 1 blockchain that powers thousands of decentralized applications.
content.description: Ethereum is a decentralized software platform built on blockchain technology. It is best known for its native cryptocurrency, ether (ETH). Developers leverage Ethereum to build decentralized technologies such as smart contracts, tokens, and decentralized applications (Dapps). Designed to be scalable, programmable, secure, and decentralized, Ethereum aims to empower innovation for developers and businesses, reshaping how numerous industries operate and influencing everyday life.
content.meta: Ethereum is a decentralized software platform based on blockchain technology. Discover Ethereum and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
